title: SUEC Event
description: SignalsKit Usage Event Convention event envelope.

event_name.description: Lowercase snake_case event name, preferably object_action or vertical_object_action. Dotted namespaces are reserved for external/server metric events.

event_properties.description: Safe operational event properties. Do not include PII.

_signalskit.description: Internal markers such as admin_visitor, admin_context and admin_marker_source. Never include identity or secrets.

timestamp.description: Optional ISO 8601 timestamp if the sender controls event time.

anonymous_id.description: Optional non-PII anonymous user or visitor ID.

user_id.description: Optional app-scoped pseudonymous authenticated user ID (for example app_user_<hash>). Never an email, raw database ID or auth-provider ID.

session_id.description: Optional session ID, kept across login to link anonymous and authenticated activity.

idempotency_key.description: Optional key to deduplicate server-side snapshot events.
